نتفاعل (form VI)
# نَتَفَاعَلُ (natafāʕalu) /na.ta.faː.ʕa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَاعَلَ (tafāʕala)
# نَتَفَاعَلَ (natafāʕala) /na.ta.faː.ʕa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاعَلَ (tafāʕala)
# نَتَفَاعَلْ (natafāʕal) /na.ta.faː.ʕal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَاعَلَ (tafāʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
